summary: The Verge's deals roundup for late October 2023 highlights discounts timed to Halloween and the start of the holiday season. The main deal is Govee's Matter-ready LED Strip Light M1 at an all-time low of $44.99. It also covers discounts on Google's Pixel Buds Pro and first-gen Pixel Watch through Wellbots promo codes, and on a Blink Video Doorbell bundle with a Blink Outdoor 4 camera.
one_line: The Verge's October 2023 deals roundup covers discounts on the Govee M1 Matter LED strip, Pixel Buds Pro, Pixel Watch and a Blink doorbell bundle.
key_facts: Govee's Matter-ready LED Strip Light M1 is on sale for an all-time low of $44.99 ($15 off) at Amazon with an on-page coupon.
The Govee LED Strip Light M1 costs $3 more ($48) direct from Govee through October 31st.
The Govee strip is 6.56 feet (2m) long, can display millions of colors and shades of white, and can sync light patterns with music.
The Govee M1 supports the newer Matter protocol, so it can be controlled with many smart home platforms.
Google's Pixel Buds Pro cost $116.99 ($83 off, 42% off from $200) at Wellbots for Verge readers with code VERGE83.
The Pixel Buds Pro are Google's first earbuds with active noise cancellation; Pixel owners get head tracking spatial audio and Clear Calling.
The first-gen Google Pixel Watch drops to $199.99 at Wellbots with code VERGEPIX80, versus a $349.99 launch price a little over a year ago.
The first-gen Pixel Watch is a 41mm model with six months of Fitbit Premium and three months of YouTube Music, and gets Wear OS 4 with Google Calendar, Gmail and Safety Check.
The Pixel Watch 2 offers better battery life, Sleep Profiles, abnormal heart rate tracking and nightly SpO2, which the first-gen lacks.
The Blink Video Doorbell with the latest Blink Outdoor security camera is $89.99 ($90 off, 50% off from $180) at Amazon.
The Blink cameras are 1080p with night vision, motion detection and two-way audio; the battery-powered Blink Outdoor 4 adds a wider field of view and person detection.
The Blink devices lack smart alerts and charge extra for cloud-based storage; the doorbell offers up to two years of battery life.
